strings.en: Myth 2: Shingles is caused by stress alone

strings.en: Myth 3: Young people don't get shingles

strings.zh: 迷思 4：擦藥膏 / 蘆薈 / 紅藥水就好，不用吃藥
strings.en: Myth 4: Topical creams, aloe, or mercurochrome are enough — no need for oral medication

strings.zh: 迷思 6：Shingrix 疫苗太貴不值得
strings.en: Myth 6: The Shingrix vaccine is too expensive to be worth it

strings.en: Does the folk "shingle-cutting ritual" really help, as PTT often asks?

strings.en: Where can I get Shingrix and how much does it cost?

strings.en: How long does post-herpetic neuralgia (PHN) last?

strings.en: What does Taiwan NHI cover for shingles?

strings.zh: 皮蛇沿著「神經節」單側分布 · Dermatome
strings.en: Shingles follows a unilateral dermatomal distribution

strings.zh: 年輕族群得皮蛇的常見情境：
近年觀察 30-40 歲族群皮蛇發生率有上升趨勢，可能與工作高壓、熬夜、慢性疲勞有關。
strings.en: In recent years, shingles incidence in the 30–40 age group has been rising, possibly linked to high work stress, sleep deprivation, and chronic fatigue.

strings.zh: 輔助治療：止痛藥、神經痛藥（Gabapentin、Pregabalin、Amitriptyline）、有時短期類固醇、嚴重時神經阻斷術。
strings.en: Adjunctive therapy: analgesics, neuropathic-pain medications (gabapentin, pregabalin, amitriptyline), sometimes short-course corticosteroids, and nerve blocks for severe cases.

strings.zh: 多數 1-3 個月內緩解，但 10-30% 持續 6 個月以上，少數痛數年。年齡越大、急性期疼痛越強、皮疹越大，PHN 風險越高。治療：Gabapentin、Pregabalin、Amitriptyline、外用 Capsaicin / Lidocaine 貼布、嚴重者神經阻斷術。
strings.en: Most resolve within 1–3 months, but 10–30% persist beyond 6 months, and a few last years. Older age, more severe acute pain, and larger rash all increase PHN risk. Treatment: gabapentin, pregabalin, amitriptyline, topical capsaicin or lidocaine patches; nerve blocks for severe cases.

strings.zh: 參考：臺灣皮膚科醫學會《帶狀疱疹疫苗接種建議》2022 年 7 月。
strings.en: Reference: Taiwanese Dermatological Association, Herpes Zoster Vaccine Recommendations, July 2022.

strings.zh: 真正會「繞圈」的可能是擴散性帶狀皰疹（disseminated zoster）— 出現在免疫嚴重低下（化療、HIV、移植），是急症需住院
strings.en: Truly "wrapping around" can occur in disseminated zoster — seen in severely immunocompromised patients (chemo, HIV, transplant); it's a medical emergency requiring hospitalization

strings.zh: 女性比男性略高，可能與停經期免疫變化有關
strings.en: Slightly higher in women, possibly related to menopausal immune changes

strings.zh: 長期熬夜爆肝 + 急性感染
自體免疫疾病（紅斑、克隆氏、IBD)+ 免疫抑制治療
strings.en: Autoimmune disease (lupus, Crohn's, IBD) + immunosuppressive therapy

strings.zh: 癌症化療、生物製劑使用者
HIV 感染者（常為首發症狀）
COVID-19 感染後 / mRNA 疫苗後（少數案例）
已完全結痂、無新水泡，抗病毒藥效益小
strings.en: Once fully crusted with no new vesicles, antiviral benefit is minimal

strings.zh: 結痂後不傳染（病毒已不在表面）
strings.en: Not contagious once crusted (virus no longer on surface)

strings.zh: 飛沫傳染少見（僅在播散性 / 黏膜病灶時），非主要途徑
strings.en: Airborne transmission is rare (only with disseminated or mucosal lesions), not the primary route

strings.zh: 額頭、眼睛周圍、鼻尖（Hutchinson sign）
strings.en: Forehead, periorbital area, nose tip (Hutchinson sign)

strings.zh: 耳朵、面部一邊不對稱無力
strings.en: Ear involvement with asymmetric facial weakness

strings.zh: 沿單側神經節分布，不會越過身體中線
strings.en: Distributes along a unilateral dermatome and does not cross the midline

strings.zh: 單一神經節（dermatome）支配的皮膚區域
strings.en: skin area innervated by a single dermatome

strings.zh: 長期壓力、睡眠不足、極度疲勞
strings.en: chronic stress, sleep deprivation, extreme fatigue
does not transmit shingles per se

strings.zh: 沒得過水痘、沒打疫苗的人感染水痘
strings.en: Causes chickenpox in those without prior chickenpox or vaccination

strings.zh: 孕婦（無水痘抗體者）、新生兒、免疫低下者、未接種過水痘疫苗的小孩
strings.en: Pregnant women without varicella immunity, newborns, immunocompromised individuals, unvaccinated children

strings.zh: 第三代非活性重組疫苗
各醫院家醫科 / 旅遊醫學科 / 部分皮膚科 / 旅遊診所自費接種
strings.en: Available at hospital family medicine / travel medicine clinics, some dermatology clinics, and travel clinics on a self-pay basis

strings.zh: 台灣每年帶狀疱疹病例約 12 萬人
strings.en: Approximately 120,000 shingles cases per year in Taiwan

strings.zh: 優先建議非活性重組疫苗（Shingrix）
只有非活性重組疫苗（Shingrix）核准
strings.en: only the non-live recombinant vaccine (Shingrix) is approved

strings.zh: 非活性重組疫苗(Shingrix)接種時程
不可在急性發作期接種

strings.en: Previously vaccinated with the live vaccine

strings.zh: 不要相信民俗斬蛇符咒
strings.en: Don't rely on folk shingle-cutting rituals

strings.zh: 繞一圈會死？疫苗值得嗎？神經痛多久？
strings.en: Is wrap-around fatal? Is the vaccine worth it? How long does the neuralgia last?

strings.en: NHI-covered; 5 times daily increases missed-dose risk
Common in Europe, less used in Taiwan

strings.zh: ≥ 50 歲；≥ 18 歲免疫低下也可
口服抗病毒藥（Valacyclovir / Famciclovir 7 天）+ 止痛 + 衛教傷口照護
strings.en: Oral antiviral (valacyclovir / famciclovir × 7 days) + analgesia + wound-care education
NSAIDs, tramadol, gabapentin, pregabalin, amitriptyline, topical capsaicin or lidocaine patches

strings.zh: 立即眼科 + 全身性抗病毒藥 + 局部抗病毒眼藥水 / 軟膏
strings.en: Immediate ophthalmology consult + systemic antiviral + topical antiviral eye drops / ointment

strings.zh: 立即耳鼻喉 + 抗病毒藥 + 短期口服類固醇 + 復健
strings.en: Immediate ENT consult + antiviral + short-course oral corticosteroid + rehabilitation

strings.zh: 住院考量，IV Acyclovir 10 mg/kg q8h × 7 天
strings.en: Consider hospitalization; IV acyclovir 10 mg/kg q8h × 7 days

strings.zh: Gabapentin/Pregabalin/Amitriptyline + 外用 + 神經阻斷術 / TENS / 心理支持
strings.en: Gabapentin / pregabalin / amitriptyline + topicals + nerve block / TENS / psychological support

strings.zh: ≥ 50 歲 → Shingrix 2 劑；免疫低下成人 ≥ 18 歲也可
strings.en: ≥ 50 years → Shingrix × 2 doses; also indicated in immunocompromised adults ≥ 18
